profile.name: Agustinus Ardhito Vedoputro
profile.title: Engineering Manager
profile.summary: Engineering Manager with 8+ years in software engineering and 5+ years leading teams, who stays hands-on in architecture and system design. Track record of designing complex distributed, event-driven systems (Redis, microservices) and scaling platforms to serve millions of users at high reliability — while growing high-performing teams and driving technical strategy across mission-critical, HRIS, and government-scale applications.

At Bukalapak, led migration of a monolithic application to microservices architecture, cutting response times from 3-5s to 100-200ms
Grew and mentored 10+ software engineers across architecture, backend, frontend, and QA
